Subject: Vendor onboarding: info required to create Redwood vendor record

Hi Lina —

Thanks for starting the onboarding process with Redwood. To get Veridian Labs into our vendor system and enable PO creation, we need the following completed and returned: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Legal entity name exactly as it appears on tax paperwork
- Federal tax ID / EIN (or VAT number for EU entities)
- Remit address and billing address (if different)
- AP contact name, email, phone for PO/invoice routing
- Bank name, bank account holder, account number (or bank letter) and ACH routing details if available
- Copy of W-9 (US) or equivalent tax certificate

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), W-9 template (for reference)

If you can return the filled form + W-9 by end of week, procurement can kick off PO creation and map your invoices to the right ledger. If anything needs to be redacted for privacy, flag it and we can arrange secure upload.

Best,
